columns.name: movie_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the movie.

columns.name: title
columns.description: The title of the movie.

columns.name: movie_status
columns.description: The status of the movie.

columns.name: number_of_production_companies
columns.description: The number of production companies that produced the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_male_characters
columns.description: The percentage of male characters in the movie.

columns.name: number_of_crews
columns.description: The number of distinct crew members that worked on the movie, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_main_characters
columns.description: The number of main characters in the movie. A main character is a cast member cast earliest. Replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: ratio_between_male_and_female_cast_members
columns.description: The ratio between male and female cast members in the movie, computed as the number of male cast members divided by the number of female cast members

models.name: movies4__production_company
models.description: Each record represents a production company.

columns.name: company_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the production company.

columns.name: company_name
columns.description: The name of the production company.

columns.name: latest_released_movie
columns.description: The latest released movie by the production company, with ties broken by the descending order of the movie title.

columns.name: most_popular_movie
columns.description: The most popular movie by the production company, with ties broken by the ascending order of the movie title.

columns.name: number_of_movies_released
columns.description: The number of movies released by the production company, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: highest_revenue_movie
columns.description: The movie title made the highest revenue among the production company's movies, with ties broken by the descending order of the movie title

columns.name: category_running_time_per_movie_2016
columns.description: Set to 3 if the production company’s average movie running time in 2016 exceeds 75% of the overall 2016 average runtime, to 2 if it exceeds 55%, to 1 if it exceeds 35%, and to 0 otherwise

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the person.

columns.name: person_name
columns.description: The name of the person

columns.name: lastest_movie
columns.description: The latest movie in which the person worked as a crew member, with ties broken by the ascending order of the movie title

columns.name: percentage_of_movie_vote_average_over_5
columns.description: The percentage of movies, in which the person worked as a crew member, that have a vote average over 5.0.

columns.name: has_worked_as_a_music_editor
columns.description: Set to 1 if the person has worked as a 'Music Editor' in the movie, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: movie_with_the_highest_average_vote
columns.description: The movie title with the highest average vote in which the person worked as a crew member, with ties broken by the descending order of the movie title

columns.name: has_movie_between_19160101_19251231
columns.description: Set to 1 if the person worked as a crew member in the movies released between 1/01/1916 and 12/31/1925, otherwise, set it to 0
